entities.summary: Maka Chichua is a Georgian singer and actress who was First Lady of Georgia between 2014 and 2018. Chichua, the longtime girlfriend of Georgian President Giorgi Margvelashvili, married the president on 10 September 2014, while he was in office, thus becoming the country's first lady.
